Method of Attack: Bypasses Outlook protections for malicious links embedded in emails using the file:// protocol with an exclamation mark added to URLs pointing to attacker-controlled servers
Allows remote code execution (RCE) when opening emails with malicious links
Bypasses Office Protected View to open malicious Office files in editing mode
Leads to leaking of local NTLM credential information
Discoverer: Check Point vulnerability researcher Haifei Li
Attack Vector: Malicious links in emails using file:// protocol with exclamation mark after document extension
Preview Pane in Outlook for maliciously crafted Office documents
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Office documents with crafted links
